obligations.title: Include PFOA/PFOS in federal-property and environmental due-diligence screening
obligations.action: Ensure PFOA/PFOS hazardous-substance status is included in applicable release, property-transfer, and due-diligence workflows; do not treat the designation alone as an automatic liability finding.
obligations.uncertainty: Specific liability depends on statutory elements, facts, defenses, contractual allocation, and current litigation posture.

obligations.title: Revalidate country FGS against OEBGD Volume 1 Change 1
obligations.action: Confirm whether each country FGS has considered the 2026 OEBGD change; record incorporated, superseded, not applicable, or interim more-protective-standard status.
obligations.uncertainty: A public FGS copy may not establish the current approved version or its incorporation status.

obligations.title: Crosswalk Korean water requirements to KEGS and installation activities
obligations.action: Identify current PFAS-relevant Korean water provisions and compare them with KEGS water, wastewater, groundwater, laboratory, and contractor requirements.
obligations.uncertainty: A statute-level source is not enough to establish the exact PFAS criterion or its applicability to a particular DoD facility.

obligations.title: Review Japan 50 ng/L PFOS/PFOA water standard for USFJ systems
obligations.action: Document whether the Japanese standard is incorporated into JEGS or otherwise applicable, verify testing frequency and methods, and identify response actions for an exceedance.
obligations.uncertainty: Applicability differs by facility status and responsibility for water supply; the national standard alone does not answer the installation question.

obligations.title: Review PFHxS-related firefighting-agent controls in Japan
obligations.action: Verify the final PFHxS-related substance group, product controls, firefighting-agent handling standards, exemptions, and procurement implications.
obligations.uncertainty: The 2025 official announcement identified a future effective date and future ministerial definition work.

obligations.title: Compare German PFAS drinking-water limits with the current GFGS
obligations.action: Obtain the current approved GFGS, compare PFAS-20 and PFAS-4 limits, and map the result to installation sampling, treatment, and response procedures.
obligations.uncertainty: The public GFGS copy is not verified as current.

obligations.title: Prepare Germany/EU PFAS firefighting-foam management review
obligations.action: Before October 23, 2026, review PFAS foam inventories, covered uses, containment, collection and treatment, labeling, management-plan requirements, and fluorine-free substitution strategy.
obligations.uncertainty: The EU restriction contains use-specific derogations; the military-vessel derogation does not automatically resolve installation or airfield applicability.
